Messages.Author: Joscha
Messages.Body:
Hi yafka,

I tinkered around a bit with Nightmare Curse.
Reason was: Often the guy without a predator wins the table. So let us reach that by shutting down predator's minions.
(Not sure of that anymore though, because you use much of your offensive power to reach that goal, better to go forward with the NCs I think).

Arguably my best approach was this, I guess:

Deck Name: Aidan's Nightmare
Created By: Joscha Düll
Description: Nightmare Curse for the win.

Crypt: (12 cards, Min: 15, Max: 28, Avg: 5,58)  4 Aidan Lyle dom AUS CHI THA 7 Tremere
2 Ash Harrison cel dom AUS THA 7 Tremere Antitribu
1 Carmen aus dom THA 5 Tremere Antitribu
2 Frondator dom tha AUS 5 Tremere Antitribu
2 Gwen Brand aus chi 3 Ravnos
1 Johann Matheson ani aus chi 4 Ravnos

Library: (70 cards)  Master (15 cards)
1 Academic Hunting Ground
4 Blood Doll
1 Chimerstry
1 Coven, The
2 Dreams of the Sphinx
1 Giant`s Blood
2 Infernal Pact (key card to get a second minion with AUS/CHI easyly)
1 Powerbase: Barranquilla
1 University Hunting Ground
1 Vessel

Action (13 cards)
5 Magic of the Smith
7 Nightmare Curse
1 Rutor`s Hand

Action Modifier (11 cards)
4 Conditioning
2 False Resonance
3 Heart`s Desire
2 Will-o`-the-Wisp (once was super-strong with Ankara Citadel, only ok after the new wording pertaining the Action Mods)

Reaction (15 cards)
6 Deflection
1 My Enemy`s Enemy
4 On the Qui Vive
2 Telepathic Misdirection
2 Wake with Evening`s Freshness

Equipment (6 cards)
1 Ankara Citadel, Turkey, The (was perfect for all the Action Mods, now is only good for NC and the Reactions, don't know, maybe can go out)
1 Bowl of Convergence
1 Camera Phone
1 Heart of Nizchetus
1 Ivory Bow
1 Ruins of Ceoris

Combo (10 cards) (definetely needs Mirror Walks, at least 4, at that time that card was unknown)
6 Mirror Image
4 Occlusion

This deck was last saved at 20:16:20 on 14.01.10

So no Hazimel, but a deck worth trying. Idk if it is enough for tourneys.
Have fun.

Baron of Frankfurt

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Joscha wrote:
> Hi yafka,
>
> I tinkered around a bit with Nightmare Curse.
> Reason was: Often the guy without a predator wins the table. So let us reach that by shutting down predator's minions.
>
This is true when "without a predator" means "the predator is not aggressive against their prey, and is fighting back to survive against their predator".
If you shut down entirely your predator, you're probably not going to win the game (but your grand-predator is).

Prince of Paris, France
